main_text.p: Datæ ex arce nostra Petershagen, 7. Septembris. 1584.
main_text.head: XVII.
RESPONSORIA DUCIS HOLSATIÆ AD HENRICUM Navarræ Regem.

p.i: Serenissime & Potentissime Rex, Domine & Consanguinee Colende.

main_text.p: LITERAS Regiæ vestræ serenitatis Neraci pridie Calendas Augusti supe-

page.notes: The running head reads "Epistola Henrici IV." with the page number 116 at left. The first line of the cont paragraph is printed as "fectu & studio cupimus commen-daveris." Some words are damaged by specks and ink spots, notably "Petershagen" and "Calendas", which are read with some uncertainty. The opening word "Literas" carries a large woodcut-style initial L, transcribed as capital. The catchword "supe-" is a line-end hyphenated word continuing onto the next page.
